categories.name: Calling
categories.definition: Requests to initiate, manage, or modify voice or video calls with contacts.

categories.name: Reminders
categories.definition: Requests to create, view, modify, or delete reminders for tasks or appointments.

categories.name: Alarms
categories.definition: Requests to set, modify, or manage alarms for waking up or specific times.

categories.name: News
categories.definition: Requests for current news headlines, stories, or updates on specific topics.

categories.name: Music
categories.definition: Requests to play, control, or seek information about music or audio playlists.

categories.name: Messaging
categories.definition: Requests to send, record, or manage text, voice, or video messages to contacts.

categories.name: Timer
categories.definition: Requests to start, stop, check, or modify countdown timers.

categories.name: Recipes & Food
categories.definition: Requests for recipes, cooking instructions, or nutritional information about food.

categories.name: Events
categories.definition: Requests for information regarding local events, activities, or things to do.

categories.name: Social
